body:
Please clarify what does it mean 
2.1.10
Verify   that there are no periodic credential rotation or password history   requirements.
--

main question is about " no periodic credential rotation " - what does it mean ? not to ask  user to change password periodically (e.g. once per year) ?

comments.body: I'm not one of the authors, but that's what I've seen this phrase refer to, so you seem to guess right.
Yes @belalena, mandatory password rotation is no longer considered to be good practice.

title: 2.1.10 (ASVS March 2019) Is unclear
